monitors.description: A single customer-blocking moderation_unavailable qualifies immediately, subject to the shared hourly cooldown. Degraded moderation retains the two-minute recurrence rule. Normal content rejections remain excluded.

limits: Image and storage failures require request traffic. Moderation also runs a fixed benign canary every 30 minutes; failed probes qualify immediately. Partial provider results from these spaced probes are diagnostic; the two-minute degraded-service rule requires recurring failures from real traffic.
Native query scheduling and log ingestion can delay delivery beyond two minutes.
The shared cooldown may defer newly affected categories until the next hourly batch. They must still be recurring then.
Cloudflare-hosted monitoring and cron share a dependency with the API; independent uptime checks are not active.
No real provider or storage outage was induced; filter timing was tested offline. Native email delivery had already been verified with sample notifications.
